name: agent:ready
description: Authorized to run. The only label that grants anything, and the one Gravity never applies.

name: agent:running
description: A worker holds the lease and is implementing; a draft pull request is open.

name: agent:review
description: The draft is ready for review, in Gravity's merge queue, or merged and still delivering.

name: agent:blocked
description: A dependency is unmet, something needs a person's decision, or every current attempt failed.

name: agent:done
description: Delivered and correlated to production; the issue is closed as completed.

name: ai:fast
description: Optional intent: this work deserves the cheapest rung. Never applied or read back by Gravity.

name: ai:auto
description: Optional intent: a declaration, and never the absence of one. Never applied by Gravity.

name: ai:deep
description: Optional intent: this work deserves the most model. Never applied by Gravity.
